historical_targets: D4 delivery V16, HTTPS V17, bridge V18, checkpoint V21 plus V18->V21 upgrade; signal V21->V22. D3 core and historical V12/V13/V14/V15; D2 historical V11. These historical groups were not all run on V22.
limitations: Trusted synthetic fixtures only. The worker adapter applies the synthetic effect after fixture exit; this does not validate arbitrary external effects inside a CLI.
Laboratory driver still starts an assignment and explicitly admits the successor. Normal idle polling, generic multi-operation loop and unattended restart recovery remain pending.
Checkpoint remains one checkpoint, exactly two ordered steps and one binding physical account. Multi-account settlement and chained checkpoints are pending.
Only live RUNNING checkpoint COMMIT; RECONCILING continuation and conclusive UNKNOWN/contradiction resolution remain excluded under A04/A09.
Stop timing is bounded in the fixture and observed on this host, not a real-time guarantee against kernel, filesystem, scheduler or arbitrary clock failures. All service clocks share one host.
Partial checkpoints keep renewing until stop/seal; closed receiver or completed SQL checkpoint rejects renewal. No worker acceptance authority or release on timeout.
CAS retries are only for SQLSTATE 40001, at most two fresh recaptures/recalculations. The pilot observed a safe stale rejection; exact retry exhaustion is not a separate Compose fault injection.
Generic artifacts/Git/rollback verifiers and part of the broader negative Compose matrix remain pending. Existing component/SQL coverage is not relabelled Compose coverage.

Images are retained locally. Only containers, networks and volumes labelled for each synthetic Compose project are cleaned. No provider, real credential, migration promotion, deployment or D4 closure.
